The '''Belsmuth sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] on the border close to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]], [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] and to the south, [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] and [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] to the west, [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] to the north and [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]] to the east.<ref name="TEA" />
